notes.title: Kickstarter Launch Date Update and Monthly Giveaway
notes.notes:
Kickstarter Launch Date Update and Monthly Giveaway

[h1]FARM FOLKS KICKSTARTER LAUNCH UPDATE[/h1]

Our team has been hard at work creating what we believe will be an amazing experience for everyone to enjoy. Progress is strong, and we're very pleased with it. We see that many of you are eager to support the project via our upcoming Kickstarter campaign, and we are truly grateful for your kindness and support. Your enthusiasm and love motivate us to work even harder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/a578dea470b0af12f372424b17f560ebb182157d.jpg[/img]


We've got extensive experience in crowdfunding, having successfully helped fund over 20 indie gaming projects via Kickstarter. We know how this process works, and timing is crucial. Despite making strong development progress, we will miss an important summer Kickstarter window. Starting in August, the back-to-school season and winter holidays will bring major AAA releases that could overshadow our campaign. We’ve decided to delay our Kickstarter launch to ensure we deliver the best possible experience.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/crytivogames/farm-folks-0][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/24f696fb35c03cd0e2142bba526fe3b04f4de824.jpg[/img][/url]

We're still working on a lot of foundational systems; there are many key game pillars that will hold the mechanics together, and we can't cut corners if we want our game to be great. We want to showcase these core mechanics in our trailer and avoid making promises we can't deliver.


We need a few extra months to get everything working as intended. With this in mind, we're aiming to push our Kickstarter launch to the end of January or the beginning of February, which means waiting an additional five months. This extra time will allow us to not only do a better job with the Kickstarter campaign but also prepare a demo for streamers and a game build for Alpha backers, likely available a month or two after the Kickstarter.

[url=https://www.farmfolksgame.com/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/4c737ef6c6293619e169a1ff28345053ffa1c2f0.jpg[/img][/url]

Even if we were to launch the Kickstarter campaign tomorrow, the Alpha wouldn't be ready until April. By delaying the launch, we ensure that the Alpha becomes available for backers shortly after the campaign, providing a more complete experience.


We hope for your understanding and support. Below you can find our roadmap. Until the Kickstarter, we will continue providing daily and monthly updates, though we might get a bit quiet as we approach the release. Make sure to head to our Kickstarter page and click the "Get Notified" button to stay in the loop.

[url=https://www.crytivo.games/farm-folks-sign-up][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/a5bc64da1ba2ecc637d53e7d34b5b1b971653087.png[/img][/url]


[b][h1]DISCORD MONTHLY GIVEAWAY[/h1][/b]
[b]We’re excited to announce our Discord Monthly Giveaways! [/b]

Each month, we will give away an exclusive cosmetic item, skin, or other in-game item on Discord. Simply join our Discord and claim it for free. These rewards will be available in-game when the game is released.


Rewards change monthly, so don’t forget to sign up for our newsletter to get notified about new rewards available to claim.


[b]THIS MONTH'S GIVEAWAY[/b]
[b]MYPOTATO BACKPACK[/b]

Claim the wholesome MyPotato backpack, featuring jiggle physics. Yes, you heard us right! The little arms and legs will jiggle around based on character motion.

[url=https://discord.gg/farmfolks][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/e9fc613458337129454d67b221bc7b29fdbb9f06.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/farmfolks][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/641b09c282981eb0630f32e4d46884adc1e5e3a0.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://discord.gg/farmfolks][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/5f82a105511cd41d23ede3d42da6bed31a38d53b.png[/img][/url]

[h1][b]NEW WEBSITE[/b][/h1]

Some of you may have noticed that we've also updated our game website, which now provides more details about what Farm Folks has to offer. As we've mentioned before, Farm Folks will deliver diverse experiences to cater to different playstyles. The game will feature detailed difficulty settings, allowing for a range of experiences. Whether you're a cozy player who prefers a relaxing, challenge-free environment, or a competitive player who thrives on the thrill of online PVPvPE challenges, there's something for everyone.

[url=https://www.farmfolksgame.com/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/e2b1f4adad219b0729dcc91127550dd984eaa42a.jpg[/img][/url]


We want Farm Folks to become a massive platform offering diverse gameplay mechanics that simulate digital life experiences, which we will be able to continuously expand and add new content to on a regular basis. Farm Folks is not your regular farming game - it's so much more. We can't wait for you all to experience it, but first, we want to make sure the game is ready. We ask for your patience and understanding🩶.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/crytivogames/farm-folks-0][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/c1ee9e6f14237bc107d07c2dabe2b487713c6e49.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://www.crytivo.games/farm-folks-sign-up][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/a5bc64da1ba2ecc637d53e7d34b5b1b971653087.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://x.com/farmfolksgame][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/beefa381162677cb2bb0518e0a7a260f0daceb9b.png[/img][/url]


Thank you, 
- Crytivo Team

notes.title: Farm Folks Devlog #8 Kickstarter Update, Latest NPCs, Automation, and more!
notes.notes:
Hello Farm Folks!


We’re excited to share with you our latest devlog. In this update, we would like to chat more about our upcoming Kickstarter and the exciting new features we're implementing into the game.


[h1]Kickstarter[/h1]

As you know, you - our incredible community - have been asking us to launch on Kickstarter. Well, we’re hard at work on crafting more than just the Kickstarter campaign page, but also an official gameplay trailer for Farm Folks! This trailer will showcase all aspects of the game: [b]farming, construction, automation, NPC interactions, machinery, animals[/b], and various means of transportation. We’re proud to say that the entirety of the trailer is shot within the game. We have no plans to use CGI outside of Unity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/56d3c3a7d9009bb06b38df581de2adf992e015a6.jpg[/img]

The gameplay trailer itself is a massive undertaking for our smaller team, but we know that it will be well worth it (we think you’ll love it)! At the same time, we are continuously developing game features and assets. It’s certainly a juggle of challenging tasks, but we’re making fruitful progress behind the scenes; some of our folks in Legendairy have seen only a fraction of what’s to come.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/8161ecdfc4e5dee219204b0c28825be801ac31e8.jpg[/img]

While our initial hope was to launch the Kickstarter towards the beginning of 2023, our scope ultimately requires more work and attention to detail. With that said, it probably comes as no surprise that we are pushing the Kickstarter launch further as we continue to craft the campaign. We see your eagerness across our channels and feel the love and support of the community; Crytivo is a small but strong team that is fully invested in seeing Farm Folks become the success you all believe it can be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/fe220063b007a986dce17a67229f483556af36e3.jpg[/img]

Though it may take a little longer for us to hit that Kickstarter launch button, we do want to introduce some Stretch Goals ahead of the Kickstarter. These Stretch Goals will help us evaluate new features and introduce them to the game based on our community preferences. Let’s call them Farm Folks Community Stretch Goals. We will reveal new goals if and when we reach the current one(s). Of course, you can influence our future picks by leaving your comments and suggestions in our [url=https://discord.gg/farmfolks]Discord[/url]. 


Please [url=https://discord.com/channels/274283563367792643/949448944117751879/1058429126144426104]check our updated FAQ section[/url] to get your questions answered regarding Kickstarter.


[h1]Farm Folks Community Stretch Goals[/h1]


[h2]5000 Kickstarter Followers Stretch Goal[/h2]
[h2]Unlocks Console Release![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/eb932f59c45ecb4bec62dce3ce70db349ea6d3aa.jpg[/img]

First and foremost, our plan is to release Farm Folks for Steam on Windows. Help us reach [b]5000 followers[/b] on our Kickstarter [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/crytivogames/farm-folks-0]promo page[/url] to unlock console support for PlayStation and Xbox! The Nintendo Switch console will be introduced as its own goal during the Kickstarter campaign. This decision is meant to account for Switch hardware limitations. If we achieve this goal in the future, our team will need to hire dedicated developers to help us port the game.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/crytivogames/farm-folks-0][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/4944ac5746d834456d8265577ba44aa44751e50e.jpg[/img][/url]

To contribute, press "Notify Me On Launch"


[h2]25000 Twitter Followers[/h2]
[h2]Unlocks Gardener Accessories[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/f7620fbde8041f4ae38d539246489edd154a5c69.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/96d02e05d62886a798e1c9d8dfaa2f063b35e076.png[/img]

With 25,000 Farm Folks Twitter followers, we will create a set of character-gardener customizations. This fancy set will include a backpack, gloves, and belt.

[url=https://twitter.com/farmfolksgame][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/a0cffcaac637b5c0c5555496e0bf5535d3b61217.jpg[/img][/url]


[h2]7500 Members on Discord[/h2]
[h2]Backpack with the Plush Cat inside[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/9e5de52c59970674898526a82a3251b87ad2af13.png[/img]

You'll never be alone when you're farming and exploring the world of Farm Folks with our Plush Cat Backpack!


[url=https://discord.gg/farmfolks][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/df570e8b166c49b733f1b1a9105300c5621350cc.jpg[/img][/url]


[h3]You can track Stretch Goal Progress on our Discord[/h3]

[url=https://discord.com/channels/274283563367792643/1111751915919913030/1111765853617279108][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/5510322c4d4f3ddc129cd35ce17b77691eee63f9.jpg[/img][/url]


And by the way, Unicow is going to be back on Kickstarter! We know how much you love Unicorn Cow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/2de740c5262394653ec2f0617727433a5654ea75.jpg[/img]

[h1]Game Updates[/h1]

[h2]NPCs[/h2]

We’re continuing to develop concepts and backstories for our town folks. These NPCs will be assigned routine life habits and have their own stories to share. Say hello to some of the newer romanceable folks from town:


[h2]Meet Ài [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/2601331a21d0a45a57b2af2208dd306781667a21.jpg[/img]

Need fashion advice or expert help when shopping for a new pair of fancy shorts? Meet Ài, a romanceable NPC, who is ready to assist you!


[h2]Meet Avril[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/f5059a434b06d44ada7712e7b371b5ce8f20b40b.jpg[/img]
Avril is a lead vocalist in a local band. She has dreams to fulfill, and she is working hard towards achieving them with or without your help. This fire-haired superstar is sure to rock your world.


[h2]Meet Micha 
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/cc8936eb7fc54d910d157e9a5841cb94087203ea.jpg[/img]
Micha might give people the cold shoulder at first, but she’ll warm up to you if you share her love of nature and passion for protecting the environment. 


[h2]Meet Mike[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/d06641bebd9a372fccb2ad91a5f315bc7171e405.jpg[/img]
As the owner of the hoverboard shop in town, Mike's success isn't something he brags about. 

He's a humble entrepreneur who may be looking for a partner to ride alongside for life.


[h2]Meet Emre[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/2e69748ad165e69de65d9098018097e90397c0fb.jpg[/img]
Emre is the resident expert on all things birds! You can often catch him birdwatching and sporting his signature quirky style.


[h2]Meet Willie [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/61feb941454645b5801fa233983c1549e9bcde2a.jpg[/img]
Willie is a dedicated lifeguard on a luxurious yacht docked at the island. With a keen eye for detail and years of experience, he takes pride in ensuring the safety of all passengers.


[h1]Character Dialogue Screen[/h1]

The design of the dialogue screen will allow you to communicate with NPCs. The background elements will change depending on your relationship status with the NPC. For instance, if you're friends with them, you might see spring flowers and a green glow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/882394235cd1bd965b48743729e053af0e52dc91.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/c9ec7b01a8c4145a26aed870568572ff5651b0cd.jpg[/img]

[h2]Dialogue Animations WIP[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/7ee63e5cac69fcc65c43baf271c2fa5a98a8a03c.gif[/img]

[h2]Your AI-powered Companion, Blackbox[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/347a09fe4eaedb1a29feefa0de29e693ac781757.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/f9c519750b7a004f68d04a4b4c2352d9317fc53b.png[/img]

In Farm Folks, you’ll have an AI powered companion that will help you navigate the world. You can decide his coloring and even choose a decorative plant for him.



[h1]Examples of Builds and Customizations[/h1]

[h2]Library[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/2dae5159dc3fc17cb37b38ec2b0f4141a612f9be.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/482719d658d291dd0fdb7833e6f9bf86675691af.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/d8540f81711889f62b025f1416293fa2d886fdeb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/5b1fe1b756b7e87e3e531344296368d41adcfaf9.jpg[/img]

[h2]Bedroom[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/0374f2cdb18be7b1f6400c557793a065ca9de7e7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/3809329b43192afc1a03d06b8de38d31388a4cd0.jpg[/img]

[h2]Stained Glass[/h2]

One of our most unique features so far is the ability to choose stained glass designs and colors for your window frames.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/148b4566343b1c217aa794a85d9c61c6cf65d0bb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/eaf884e05b68510365f03c628b33cf5ad02edfd9.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/c6b359f3bce00a4ef69e7a72d717508a2c97456f.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/fdaaa22c396ffb74f173a02966406f2a1caf40f9.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/200c50e4db80cfd652dab44fab6490925a501ffe.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/7c1fb164bd1d77399b746cbde24ea57715c93423.jpg[/img]


[h1]Automation and Factories[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/d686f4a72063fb1ecfd4af83fddb3be674aa06a0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/b26bd1daf4beee7ea525574079798a14664f7396.gif[/img]

Our team has spent a great deal of time developing automation systems for the game. We are excited to share that Farm Folks now has electricity and electric generators!. Wind turbines generate electricity based on their positioning in the world (the higher they are the better), wind direction, and intensity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/05d3ba9d0e2823fc8f6763aabf4afe692cef0d80.jpg[/img]

We’ve also developed and implemented our hydraulic railing system! This automation will allow you to connect machines together and deliver resources to places quickly and more efficiently. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/9f3d4feb7150393faf6e7cfa379cc6bad1894e85.png[/img]

Sneak peek at a Town Building

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/9b4981915c0858595a3a72f502c35cf9eb64f263.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/2bc5d4f0e616667de81e33e6431eda092cf206aa.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/64ee510ce60c5c6fcb500fdf93fa86d62086172a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/2a7ff05a2b99fee696098007f4f1d71250032f5f.jpg[/img]

There’s plenty more to see as our development progresses with near daily updates on both [url=https://discord.gg/farmfolks]Discord[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/farmfolksgame]Twitter[/url]. Be sure to follow along and help us shape the game with your input, suggestions, and voting!


Until next time!

The Crytivo Team

notes.title: Farm Folks February 2022 Dev Update #3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/9ed61bd3822da254e459d71c7240be4a2a233650.gif[/img]

[b]Hello farming engineers![/b]

And we’re back with another portion of exciting updates for you. Our team has been working incredibly hard setting up the environments for the game’s future technology. The [i]Farm Folks[/i] world is evolving each and every day and we daresay it’s looking really, really great! We hope you’re as excited as we are about the future of [i]Farm Folks[/i] and, as always, we invite you to leave us your thoughts and comments below. [url=https://discord.gg/farmfolks]You can also join the conversation on our Discord.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/1cb893fea83b29f0c8d4ff4cf4fb45387466720e.jpg[/img]

To help us advance our development further, we recently introduced a Patreon-like fan support system that allows anyone who’s eager to be closer to development to donate a monthly contribution. This fan system allows supporters to be among the first to see content in development by our talented art and dev team. It’s been a great success and we received support from so many fans - both old and new - that have helped us to do more for [i]Farm Folks[/i] by hiring remote artists, animators, illustrators, etc. [url=https://crytivo.com/en/farm-folks-news/december-2021-dev-update]You can read more about it here.[/url]

At the same time, we’ve been posting plenty of Legendairy and VIP updates which have allowed close fans to participate in the development of the game as we progress. Whether something needs adjustments, some TLC, or we find a lot of interest and love around a piece of the project, we pride ourselves on receiving feedback and aren’t afraid to have our decisions influenced for the better. YOU are helping us create [i]Farm Folks[/i] so thank you to everyone for your contributions and support. Please consider becoming a supporter and check out the tiers below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/e1b772af95d169e0ba86ec03602aba59bc23afd4.jpg[/img]

Alright, enough bragging! Here is what we’ve accomplished, what is in production, and what’s next. You all are probably fed up with the pillows, sofas, and lights anyway. [i]Farm Folks[/i], at its core, is a farming and life sim game and we have no plans to deviate from that direction. We’re working on the core elements first (technical implementation system) that will allow you to build, customize, and place objects in the world. The core system to support those functions is complete! 

[b]Let’s talk about Modularity in the game[/b]

Our goal is to give you the tools that will enable your creativity as a player. We’re working on an intuitive and familiar modular construction system to help spur this creativity and freedom. By selecting the right construction modules, you can build anything you want: a barn for cows, a chicken coop, your living room, or a stunning kitchen. You will be able to select from various modules like windows, doors, short wall, long wall, staircase, railing, etc. And you’re not only able to choose the material of the module (i.e. wood, brick, stone, or concrete), you will also be able to paint it however you’d like or even wrap it in a beautiful wallpaper. Don’t forget to invite your friends to help you design all of these projects since [i]Farm Folks[/i] supports 4 players co-op.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/18a51145c0dcb43813baacd57263afcb9580ff98.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/fb69d849b0f97a3acca17c1008bc02d6dbd69937.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/51e79ae755f0a407c1ddcd4dc8bb02590d4ad49e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/cdf60e4c58168957611a488c54d54e7ec7ee373d.gif[/img]
[previewyoutube=wZXSMlcfuLE;full][/previewyoutube]

As a side note, structures can have any amount of floors and rooms. There has never been a farming life sim game like this before. [b]Your imagination is your limitation™[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/84ccd5c145555665e3bfe9698c7eeed86ebbf5bc.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/85ed426f1d9a39f7b249d75a8569b9944774983b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/ffed2ef6bce19b95b9936a54803d2349cebef448.gif[/img]

You also will have a place to create building presets and share them with other players online. This way, players that would love to build buildings at once can save a lot of time and grinding by placing packaged building blocks (this system will see the light a bit later in development).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/f5ebaab11a7ac50d202d95b03c1f0101599d13cd.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/c59d996b34231fbd31091bd39cbc41fb2dd5c577.jpg[/img]

[b]FARMING[/b]

You can start farming anywhere you want! By selecting the hoe tool, you can start making plots and planting crops. We also designed modular planters that come with 3 height variations: low, medium, and high. These planters can be placed indoors or outdoors. When you place a single planter, it becomes a single flower pot. However, by merging a few planters together, you can build unique shapes and create beautiful green ferns or even a maze! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/96137cbfc96539994b29ac22eb74812dc96ff631.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/9414db2685d24967d9d0c7c623f83d3bd880e2e7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/c448206331f2614c081f5afdac813f3baa47cc1d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/7fa8cbaff2c831c2189005b5ac584f69ef193aa3.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=07WFdfce0Po;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/077901a70b48c07d23adb3878a499eca6d1e1723.jpg[/img]

Plants will have multiple growth states and personal statistics. It will be important to water them based on plant needs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/cf7e629090613917a1f6aa16426fd73fbf579e9d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/2cfbb94960c35e1735f2082eaf35c07be8b58c0f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/511e3b3de87d2c0f50718a354df6c66e74cccbe0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/561b52ddb03c8d13cc6ab797da95fb6fb503da60.png[/img]

[b]FERTILIZERS[/b]

Fertilization will play an important role in the plant’s growth and will give plants unique characteristics or advantages. You can read more about fertilizers in our previous post [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/895160/view/3021326929200859163]here[/url]. We’re planning to talk more about fertilizers down the road.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/235c122d30b4e3416c9a200873788f0d38448c46.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/1c5f91ee396230cb7e25fedae7f086e8a14bb6f7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/10a60a4edb589b17870e92830f9fc7440eeef064.gif[/img]

[b]GENES[/b]

We’re planning to add a plant gene system that will allow new plants to inherit characteristics of previous generations. If you get lucky enough and get a tomato with a unique color, you’ll be able to save its seeds and mix them with other colors to yield a very unique and blended palette. You will be able to sell unique plants for a greater price in the city too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/f31e85631304b5257f7375b3ec5adf52f21ea214.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/f5181bbee1e0aa838b359380b9ea6a48a0c5de46.jpg[/img]

[b]THE WORLD[/b]

We decided not to chase realism too much and make the world of [i]Farm Folks[/i] mysterious and unique. Everything takes place in a near-future where technology is evolving and helping people lead happier lives. The world will have familiar plants and animals but it will also have unique and never-before-seen species. There will be scary caves full of unknown and isolated islands where no human has ever gone before. We’ll certainly be talking more about these mysteries in the future so be sure to sign-up for our email updates, just in case. You don’t want to miss it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/56852421132efc24348a3e3e6cf2961b431e44d5.jpg[/img]

We started putting together our ‘prototype island,’ as we call it. This island is quite small and allows us to test most of the systems while we continuously build bigger worlds on either side. You will probably see changes to the geography as we release updates. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/1e15a4ee500d5df796f9029dc84580cf5e6ad171.jpg[/img]

[b]BACKPACKS[/b]

What engineer travels around without a backpack or suitcase? We’re designing various backpacks for you to carry on your adventures! Fill them with anything you need: crafting materials, crop supplies, or tools. Backpacks will have different capacities and can be found on the island in crates. You can also purchase backpacks in the city, win them as a reward during festivals, or receive them as a gift from your favorite NPC. Let us know in the comments which one is your favorite or if we should add one you have in mind.

[b]WATERING[/b]

Nothing can live without water, right? Our plants in the game love water and they will require you to pay proper attention and water them regularly. Our goal with the watering system is to give you the ability to be efficient and carry water with you at any time. We invented [b]Waterblee [/b]- a modern watering system that can be attached to your backpack! It comes with a replaceable water canister and watering handle. You can carry multiple canisters of water with you, as long as you have enough space in your backpack. Later on in the game, you’ll have automatic watering systems that can be installed and set up to water plants ‘automagically.’

[b]OPTIMIZATION AND TECH[/b]

We’re spending a good amount of time considering low level systems as our goal is to create a beautiful world and, at the same time, allow as many people as possible to experience it by optimizing every step of this process. We started working on the foliage system and created our very first tree type. Chopping a tree will be a very satisfying process (of course, with every tree you chop you can plant two more in the world). A tree will chip out at the place where the axe meets the trunk and it will directionally fall based on the cut with real time physics. Branches will have animation bones, allowing branches to stay above the ground and not sink in - just like the real world.

[b]ANIMATIONS[/b]

The animations that you saw earlier are mostly placeholders and we are now starting to design the animations we actually need. Currently, we’re working on basic animations such as walking, jogging, running, etc. We’re working with our new animator on a character setup and, as a result, there’s multiple iterations and back and forth discussions as we adjust everything we need to have a cohesive project. It’s hard, but it’s shaping up pretty well. Here are some examples of animations (all still work in progress).

[b]WHAT’S NEXT[/b]

We will continue working on farming elements, planting, watering, and growing plants. We’re also beginning the implementation of farm animals! We started with the turkey family and we will be adding chickens next. Additionally, some of our artists started to work on kitchen furniture. Kitchens will have a lot of functionality as you’ll be able to cook food on the stovetop, store food in the fridge or closets, wash dishes, serve dinner, etc. Food can spoil and affect the environment which can lead to sickness or unimpressed guests.
